initialExam.title: SSC Junior Engineer 2025-26
initialExam.description: Junior Engineer exam for Civil, Mechanical, Electrical posts. Tier-1 result declared 6 Mar 2026; Tier-2 completed 7 Apr 2026; Tier-2 result awaited.
initialExam.eligibility: Diploma or Degree in Engineering from recognized institution
initialExam.syllabus: Paper-I: General Intelligence & Reasoning (50Q), General Awareness (50Q). Paper-II: Civil/Electrical/Mechanical Engineering (300 marks).
initialExam.examPattern: Paper-I: 200 questions, 200 marks, 2 hours. Paper-II: 100 questions, 300 marks, 2 hours (Technical).
initialExam.selectionProcess: Paper-I (CBT) → Paper-II (CBT) → Document Verification → Final Selection
initialExam.jobRole: Junior Engineer in CPWD, CWC, BRO, MES and other government departments
initialExam.careerGrowth: JE → Assistant Engineer → Executive Engineer → Superintending Engineer.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit ssc.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form with engineering details 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, Medical, Pension

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years
